title: habenaria occidentalis
intro: Habenaria occidentalis, commonly known as Western Yellow-fringed Orchid, is a terrestrial orchid species native to North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria occidentalis include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects, which contribute to its use in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
